d.d: The fourteenth numeral symbol of the English alphabet, called en and written in the Latin script.
Contraction of and, chiefly used in set phrases.
The rotational speed of the low-pressure spool of a multiple-spool gas turbine engine, often expressed as a percentage of a certain reference rotational speed.

The rotational speed of the high-pressure spool of a two-spool gas turbine engine or the intermediate-pressure spool of a three-spool gas turbine engine, often expressed as a percentage of a certain reference rotational speed.
The rotational speed of the high-pressure spool of a three-spool gas turbine engine, often expressed as a percentage of a certain reference rotational speed.
Used when giving the former name of a man.
Used when giving a man's name of birth, which was legally changed after.
